annotation.title_clean: We Robot 2025: Connecting Global Robotics and AI
annotation.title_en: We Robot 2025: Connecting Global Robotics and AI
annotation.venue: Canadian Journal of Law and Technology
annotation.summary_en: Editorial introducing a special issue of the Canadian Journal of Law and Technology featuring papers from We Robot 2025, held at the University of Windsor. It describes the interdisciplinary conference and summarizes seven papers on robotic agriculture, delivery robot expressiveness, AI interoperability, generated personal data, generative AI contracts, and facial recognition.
key_provisions_or_claims: We Robot 2025 was the first in-person We Robot in Canada, hosted at Windsor Law.
Conference is interdisciplinary, bringing together lawyers, roboticists and artists on robot and AI regulation.
Special issue papers cover robotic agriculture and labour control, and expressive delivery robots.
Other papers address interoperable AI regulation, generated personal data under the GDPR, and facial recognition.
